journal_lines: Did not make a sound. Not one. Three hours of perfect silence. Emerged with mud on the paws and a look you don't ask about.
Something in the deep dark was listening. Moved very slowly. Very quietly. It was enough.
The sculk was everywhere. Stayed still until the heartbeat noise stopped. Came back.
Moved between sculk sensors in complete silence. It worked. Once.
The heartbeat sound stopped. Did not move until it started again and stopped again.
Whatever is in the deep dark, it decides what leaves. Decided to let me leave.
Three hours. Not a sound. Came up with mud on everything and eyes that didn't meet others.
Stayed still for longer than seemed necessary. Turned out to be exactly necessary.
The deep dark has its own rules. Followed them. Came back.
The vibration of breathing was almost too much. Almost.
Six steps in the dark with something very large moving parallel. Held the breath.
Emerged eventually. Intact. Would not go back.
